description: Find a Spanish municipality, province or comunidad autónoma by name and get its place_id. Accepts any spelling; works best with the official Spanish name (e.g. "Marbella", "Palma", "Jávea" / "Xàbia", "Islas Baleares"). Returns candidates with the regions they belong to. Pass queries to look up several places in one call. (Buscar municipio, provincia o comunidad autónoma.)

queries.description: Several place names at once (up to 25), instead of query.

name: find_place
title: Find a place in Spain
